item.title: What are the main events for today?
item.description: EUROPEAN SESSIONIn the European session, the only highlight is the Eurozone Flash CPI. The Headline CPI Y/Y is expected at 1.7% vs 1.7% prior, while the Core Y/Y is seen at 2.2% vs 2.2% prior. The data is not going to change anything for the ECB as central banks are trying to assess the impact from the US-Iran conflict on growth and inflation.
